record.body:
## Problem

Waiting rows say `◌ waiting` without saying what they wait on. Running rows do not show how long they have run, so a stuck executor looks like a healthy one. Every grouped row repeats its phase slug, which the section header already shows, and that column takes width from the title. Failed checks and failed reports in Activity look the same as passes.

## Approach

- Model (`scripts/dashboard_model.py`): list work-items with `--full` to read `relationships.depends_on`. TaskRow gains `waits_on` (slugs of dependencies that are not done) and `running_since` (recorded_at of the latest assignment for that work-item, only while it is in progress). ActivityItem gains `failed` (check-run result fail, or execution-report result or verdict fail).
- App (`scripts/dashboard_app.py`): a waiting row's title ends with a muted "waits on a, b"; a running row's status reads "running 14m"; the task detail chips show the same running time. Drop the phase column from the phase-grouped task table; keep it in `--once`, which is not grouped. Failed activity lines use the error colour and a ✗ glyph.
- Keep the 60-column layout: the waits-on note clips with the title.

## Exit criteria

- Model tests for waits_on, running_since, and ActivityItem.failed.
- Pilot tests for the waits-on note, running time, the missing phase column at both widths, and red failed activity lines.
- A tmux popup test shows these on screen; the full suite passes.
